The Studio

A calm, clean space to get sharp.

Bolton Barber Studio Denver is a modern barber suite in Wheat Ridge — no chaos, no rushing. Just skilled hands, good light, and time to get your look exactly right.

Whether it’s a tight skin fade, a clean beard line, or a classic hot-towel shave, the standard is the same at every chair: precise, unhurried, and finished properly.

  • Detail-first fades and tapers
  • Beard shaping & hot-towel shaves
  • Book ahead or walk in
  • Cash and all major cards

FAQ

Good to know

A few quick answers before you book. Still have a question? Call us or tap the chat.

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes — walk-ins are welcome whenever a chair is open. Booking ahead is the surest way to guarantee your time, so we recommend it for evenings and Saturdays.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking form above, call (303) 901-1163, or tap the chat button and our assistant will set you up in a few messages.

Do you do beard work and shaves?

Absolutely. We offer beard shaping, crisp lineups, and classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves — on their own or paired with a cut.

How much does a cut cost?

Cuts start from $35 and fades from $40. Final pricing depends on length and detail, so call ahead and we’ll give you an exact quote.

What payment do you accept?

Cash and all major cards. Tips are always appreciated but never expected.
